title: rapidtrees: fast all-pairs phylogenetic tree distances
description: rapidtrees is a high-performance Rust library, with Python bindings and a command-line interface, for all-pairs phylogenetic tree distances: Robinson-Foulds, weighted Robinson-Foulds and Kuhner-Felsenstein.
